description: This file manages internationalization (i18n) for the application, including language data, language switching, and translation functions.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the current language, loads language data, and updates document attributes.

methods.name: t
methods.description: Translates a given key path into the current language, with optional replacements and fallback.

methods.name: useI18n
methods.description: Custom hook that provides translation function and current language code for React components.
